metadata_snapshot_failure.name: metadata_snapshot_failure
metadata_snapshot_failure.value: "metadata_snapshots"."failure_present" = 0 OR ("metadata_snapshots"."failure_code" IS NOT NULL AND "metadata_snapshots"."failure_message" IS NOT NULL)

tracking_connection_credentials.name: tracking_connection_credentials
tracking_connection_credentials.value: "tracking_connection"."state" <> 'connected' OR ("tracking_connection"."account_id" IS NOT NULL AND "tracking_connection"."credential_id" IS NOT NULL)

preparation_progress_shape.name: preparation_progress_shape
preparation_progress_shape.value: "preparation_tasks"."progress_present" = 0 OR ("preparation_tasks"."progress_ended" IS NOT NULL AND ("preparation_tasks"."progress_percent" IS NULL OR "preparation_tasks"."progress_percent" BETWEEN 0 AND 100))

preparation_state_shape.name: preparation_state_shape
preparation_state_shape.value: ("preparation_tasks"."status" IN ('queued', 'processing', 'cancelling', 'ready') AND "preparation_tasks"."failure_reason" IS NULL AND ("preparation_tasks"."status" <> 'queued' OR "preparation_tasks"."progress_present" = 0)) OR ("preparation_tasks"."status" = 'failed' AND "preparation_tasks"."failure_reason" IS NOT NULL) OR ("preparation_tasks"."status" = 'cancelled' AND "preparation_tasks"."failure_reason" IS NOT NULL AND "preparation_tasks"."failure_reason" IN ('cancelled', 'cache-deleted'))

subtitle_asset_result.name: subtitle_asset_result
subtitle_asset_result.value: ("subtitle_assets"."status" = 'failed' AND "subtitle_assets"."error_code" IS NOT NULL) OR ("subtitle_assets"."status" IN ('pending', 'ready') AND "subtitle_assets"."error_code" IS NULL)
